pages.title: O nó intacto
pages.layout: single wide courtyard with tiny object-only knot inset
pages.scene: Caio LEFT and Sere RIGHT inspect the suspended rope-net knot and pale linen marker on the established east training yard; knot remains tight, Sere holds the rope apart from his hand; no students behind them.

lines.speaker: Caio
lines.text: Não se soltou. A curva veio da minha mão.

lines.speaker: Sere
lines.text: O nó está firme. Vamos repetir sem a rede.

pages.title: A fita no aro
pages.layout: large action panel and narrow ribbon detail
pages.scene: Sere LEFT suspends a single linen ribbon from a small wooden hoop; Caio RIGHT holds his open hand a safe distance below; the ribbon angles toward his hand, with target racks behind; no storm.

lines.speaker: Sere
lines.text: Primeiro diga de onde vem o vento.

lines.speaker: Caio
lines.text: Da porta sul... mas esta fita virou contra ele.

pages.title: Oru observa
pages.layout: low angle scale contrast and object-only insert
pages.scene: Oru adult short gnome LEFT about one meter tall with copper spectacles and single braided white beard examines three linen strips on a hoop; Caio RIGHT stands still, visibly taller; Sere called him but remains outside this image; courtyard consistent.

lines.speaker: Oru
lines.text: Não tente mandar. Observe as três fitas.

lines.speaker: Caio
lines.text: Uma reage ao meu braço; as outras, ao pátio.

pages.title: Lentes ao vento
pages.layout: comedy action close-up with lower wide reaction panel
pages.scene: One linen strip blows across Oru's round copper spectacles while adult Oru LEFT catches it; Caio RIGHT lowers his hand, embarrassed but amused; gentle natural wind, no conjured cyclone; no duplicated figures.

lines.speaker: Oru
lines.text: Descobrir não é dominar, rapaz.

lines.speaker: Caio
lines.text: Desculpe. Amanhã começo por aprender a parar.

pages.title: O saco de cereal
pages.layout: dynamic diagonal action with sack-only insert
pages.scene: Tovo LEFT, tall broad sage-green half-orc in amber kitchen apron, impulsively lifts one heavy cereal sack across the wet kitchen threshold; Sere RIGHT notices his shoulder strain and reaches to warn from a safe position; no magic glow; only two people.

lines.speaker: Tovo
lines.text: Eu consigo pôr o saco na mesa!

lines.speaker: Sere
lines.text: Tovo, espera! O chão está molhado!

pages.title: O ombro cobra
pages.time: Dia 481 · fim da tarde, instantes depois
pages.layout: tight emotional panel and fallen-sack object detail
pages.scene: Same kitchen; Tovo LEFT has put the heavy sack down and supports his right shoulder in pain, standing with torso facing forward and head naturally aligned; Sere RIGHT steadies him without yanking arm, flour on apron; no visible dislocation.

lines.speaker: Tovo
lines.text: O saco aguentou. Meu ombro, não.

lines.speaker: Sere
lines.text: Não prove mais nada. Vamos à enfermaria.

pages.title: Primeiro, imobilizar
pages.layout: medical two-shot with bandage detail
pages.scene: In established east infirmary, adult human healer LEFT olive skin dark brown hair braided bun, navy tunic cream sleeves examines Tovo RIGHT with his right arm supported in a simple sling, three linen beds under gothic windows, blue four-moon banner; no instant healing.

lines.speaker: Curandeira
lines.text: Nada rompeu. O tendão precisa de repouso.

lines.speaker: Tovo
lines.text: Então hoje corto o pão com a outra mão.

pages.title: Força não é licença
pages.time: Dia 481 · começo da noite, minutos depois
pages.layout: adult gnome at bedside and close-up of sling
pages.scene: Oru LEFT short adult gnome with round copper glasses and single silver beard braid stands beside infirmary bed; Tovo RIGHT seated upright in sling, anxious rather than clownish; fixed beds and cabinet.

lines.speaker: Oru
lines.text: Foi um impulso de força própria, não proteção.

lines.speaker: Tovo
lines.text: E se eu fizer isso de novo?

pages.title: Dividir o peso
pages.layout: quiet friendship two-shot
pages.scene: Caio LEFT sits beside infirmary bed with a light half-filled grain sack resting on floor; Tovo RIGHT in sling confesses his fear; neither lifts load; moonlight through east gothic windows.

lines.speaker: Caio
lines.text: Da próxima, dividimos a carga.

lines.speaker: Tovo
lines.text: Achei que ser forte era nunca pedir ajuda.

pages.title: A margem permitida
pages.layout: council table with authorized map detail
pages.scene: Adra LEFT slate-green orc ferry captain with shell-bound dark braids lays Enseada letter on school council table; Ilyan RIGHT long wavy black hair clean-shaven 18-year-old studies public-margin route; map shows no forest entry, gallery opening or stone removal.

lines.speaker: Adra
lines.text: A Enseada permite visita só pela margem pública.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: Então precisamos ainda da licença da cidade.

pages.title: Dois dias de espera
pages.time: Dia 483 · tarde, depois da reunião, na eclusa
pages.layout: municipal paperwork and route scene
pages.scene: After the council meeting Eda LEFT municipal surveyor with short dark curls, teal cape and scale staff checks the damaged sluice in person from its safe stone walkway; Sere RIGHT dark-brown elf with one silver braid and green cloak listens. River and sluice are physically behind them; neither grants departure yet.

lines.speaker: Eda
lines.text: Só assino depois de mais dois dias na eclusa.

lines.speaker: Sere
lines.text: Minha ausência precisa de substituição.

pages.title: Os turnos não somem
pages.layout: registrar desk with ledgers close-up
pages.scene: Ordelia LEFT olive skin iron-grey low braid wine dress brass keys points to forge roster at familiar school secretariat; Ilyan RIGHT clean-shaven and long black wavy hair proposes swapping three afternoon forge shifts; no teleport or sudden permission.

lines.speaker: Ordelia
lines.text: Quem assume suas três tardes na forja?

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: Troco com um colega e Teren assina.

pages.title: Carta à vila
pages.layout: lamp-lit letter scene and envelope insert
pages.scene: Ilyan LEFT writes a physical letter to Nima at simple Cedar dorm desk; Caio RIGHT ties ordinary mail satchel near door, clearly at school; Nima is NOT present, no apparition or portrait; no readable exact lettering on paper.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: Peço a Nima os desenhos de dobradiças antigas.

lines.speaker: Caio
lines.text: A resposta não chegará antes da licença.

pages.title: Falha de ferramenta
pages.layout: two-shot at dorm desk with second letter close detail
pages.scene: Same Cedar dorm; Ilyan LEFT seals a separate letter to his father Bram about the accidental ember; Caio RIGHT points to marked delivery days on mail ledger; physical letters only.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: Conte ao meu pai até do prego que caiu.

lines.speaker: Caio
lines.text: Ele sempre diz que ferramenta se conhece pela falha.

pages.title: A concha limpa
pages.layout: cleared forge safety setup
pages.scene: In east forge day486, Oru LEFT short adult gnome checks stone spoon with existing lit ember on clean table; Ilyan RIGHT clean-shaven young man waits hands away; sand bucket, iron lid, no sawdust; Teren and healer supervise off camera but not speaking.

lines.speaker: Oru
lines.text: Uma chama já acesa. Areia, tampa e saída livres.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: Se tremer, eu digo parei.

pages.title: Um fio de chama
pages.layout: restrained flame action with tiny coal-only inset
pages.scene: Ilyan LEFT carefully guides an already burning coal's tiny flame from rim toward center of stone spoon without creating new fire; Teren RIGHT dark-skinned bald smith square grey beard ready with iron lid; clear table and sand bucket; no giant blast.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: Só a chama aderida ao carvão...

lines.speaker: Teren
lines.text: Ela ficou dentro da concha. Mantenha a distância.

pages.title: Parei
pages.layout: single emotional close-up with lid detail
pages.scene: Ilyan LEFT withdraws his shaking hand and speaks stop; Teren RIGHT immediately covers tiny coal in stone spoon with iron lid; no burned person, no escaping fire, the test ends.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: Parei. Minha mão começou a tremer.

lines.speaker: Teren
lines.text: Boa decisão. Encerramos a prova.

pages.title: Sem título novo
pages.layout: routine work with notes and wheel plate detail
pages.scene: Oru LEFT records distance and duration, adult short gnome with copper spectacles; Ilyan RIGHT returns to ordinary sanding of Folealto metal wheel plate in east forge; no ceremonial promotion.

lines.speaker: Oru
lines.text: Anoto duração e distância. Nada de título.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: Tenho uma chapa para terminar.

pages.title: O que ela admira
pages.layout: gentle well-side two-shot with water detail
pages.scene: At familiar school central courtyard well, Runa LEFT straight long black hair straight fringe septum ring left floral arm tattoo in dark plum medieval clothes rests fingers gently on Ilyan RIGHT sleeve, away from forge heat; Ilyan clean-shaven long wavy black hair, youthful; warm restrained intimacy, no kiss.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: Eu admiro que tenha dito: parei.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: Pensei que admirasse uma chama maior.

pages.title: A mão de Pim
pages.layout: infirmary two-shot with bandaged hand inset
pages.scene: Adult stocky gnome net-maker Pim LEFT red worn headscarf, copper-grey full beard, cream shirt brown vest presents a rope-burned palm with embedded fibers to adult healer RIGHT olive skin and dark braided bun; clean water and forceps in fixed east infirmary; hand still injured.

lines.speaker: Pim
lines.text: A corda molhada queimou até os sulcos.

lines.speaker: Curandeira
lines.text: Vou tirar as fibras, uma de cada vez.

pages.title: Consentimento antes da água
pages.layout: patient consent two-shot with basin inset
pages.scene: Runa LEFT straight black hair/fringe, septum ring, left floral tattoo holds damp cloth beside real basin; adult gnome Pim RIGHT red scarf and grey-copper beard watches alert with injured palm resting on clean linen, agrees; healer supervises nearby off frame, no instant cure.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: Posso guiar um fio de água? A curandeira vigia.

lines.speaker: Pim
lines.text: Pode. Se arder demais, eu aviso.

pages.title: A fibra sobe
pages.layout: water technique wide panel plus hand-only inset
pages.scene: Runa LEFT carefully conducts actual clean basin water along damp cloth over Pim's wounded palm at center (Pim only hand shown; avoid extra faces); healer RIGHT with forceps watches; a single rope fiber appears at surface, wound does not magically close.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: Achei uma fibra sob a crosta.

lines.speaker: Curandeira
lines.text: Pare o fluxo. Eu retiro com a pinça.

pages.title: A pinça
pages.layout: careful removal with tool detail
pages.scene: Healer LEFT removes visible rope fiber with forceps from adult gnome Pim RIGHT injured palm, Pim grits teeth but remains still; clean basin, open wound, no gore; Runa outside frame.

lines.speaker: Curandeira
lines.text: Pronto. Agora verifico o sangramento.

lines.speaker: Pim
lines.text: Ainda dói. Mas sinto a fibra sair.

pages.title: Não é milagre
pages.layout: quiet medical result at the infirmary ledger
pages.scene: The brown-haired healer LEFT records Pim's care at the fixed east infirmary desk. Runa RIGHT, with straight black hair and fringe, septum piercing, and floral tattoo on her left arm, listens and answers. Pim remains off frame with his hand dressed by the healer.

lines.speaker: Curandeira
lines.text: A fibra saiu. A carne cicatriza no tempo dela.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: Então registro cuidado, não uma cura pronta.

pages.title: O registro do risco
pages.time: Dia 487 · fim da manhã, pouco depois
pages.layout: infirmary parchment record inset
pages.scene: The east infirmary's written record documents Pim's still open rope wound, the healer's extraction of one embedded fiber, supervised water use, clean dressing, rest, and restriction from rope work. A document beat between treatment and class.
pages.narration: Registro da enfermaria: Pim precisa de curativo, repouso e dias longe das cordas. A água ajudou a expor a fibra; não fechou a ferida.

pages.title: A maçã cortada
pages.layout: elemental classroom demonstration with apple-only detail
pages.scene: In established elemental classroom, adult short gnome Oru LEFT with copper glasses, single silver beard braid displays cut apple on demonstration table; Runa RIGHT guides a little real clean water between apple fibers from basin; missing slice remains missing, no regeneration.

lines.speaker: Oru
lines.text: A água percorre a polpa. E a fatia?

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: Continua separada. Não nasceu outra.

pages.title: A pergunta que fere
pages.layout: hostile rivals separated by classroom aisle
pages.scene: Líria LEFT copper-olive skin, two TIGHT dark braids, chin scar, grey coat red seams chained notebook stands on OPPOSITE side of wide classroom aisle from Runa RIGHT straight black hair/fringe septum and left floral tattoo. They glare; compulsory class not joint study, no smiles, no touch, no sharing desk. Apple/basin in background. Prior violence unresolved.

lines.speaker: Líria
lines.text: Água baixa o inchaço. Vai esconder o corte também?

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: Se esconder, a curandeira examina de novo.

pages.title: Limite escrito
pages.layout: teacher and student at separate desk with notebook inset
pages.scene: Oru LEFT explains written rule beside cut apple; Runa RIGHT reads a PUBLIC circulating class notebook left on teacher's desk, a technical note on stone pressure not evidence of who laid stone; Líria absent and no friendly exchange.

lines.speaker: Oru
lines.text: Uma melhora visível não prova reparo da carne.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: Nem sentir pressão revela quem pôs a pedra.

pages.title: Caderno, não trégua
pages.layout: tense corridor two-shot with locked cabinet detail
pages.scene: Líria LEFT clutches her OWN brass-chained notebook and passes east corridor without stopping; Ordelia RIGHT wine dress low iron-grey braid brass keys warns her that compulsory class is no reconciliation. Líria's chin scar visible, expression hard.

lines.speaker: Líria
lines.text: A aula acabou. Não devo conversa à Runa.

lines.speaker: Ordelia
lines.text: A escola exige respeito, não amizade.

pages.title: Do arco à pena
pages.layout: training yard diagonal action
pages.scene: Caio LEFT aims a real bow at the target while Sere RIGHT supervises at the north range. After this familiar exercise, she asks him to move only a loose feather with air; no giant vortex.

lines.speaker: Caio
lines.text: Com o arco, consigo ler o vento cruzado.

lines.speaker: Sere
lines.text: Guarde o arco. Agora mova só uma pena solta.

pages.title: Poeira no olho
pages.layout: comic mishap with dust-only inset
pages.scene: Caio LEFT accidentally drives feather too hard and light dust toward Tovo RIGHT tall sage-green half-orc with right shoulder bandage, who rubs ONE eye; Caio immediately lowers hands and apologizes; no physical duplication.

lines.speaker: Caio
lines.text: Foi forte demais. Desculpa, Tovo.

lines.speaker: Tovo
lines.text: Só entrou pó. Busca água, depois tenta menor.

pages.title: Três correntes
pages.layout: instructional spatial scene with three ribbons inset
pages.scene: Sere LEFT has hung three separate linen ribbons at knee height in east training yard; Caio RIGHT kneels and reads natural air from door, sun-heated wall, and his own movement, without controlling; chalk circle and target racks fixed.

lines.speaker: Sere
lines.text: Qual fita recebe o ar da parede quente?

lines.speaker: Caio
lines.text: A do meio. A última se move quando eu ando.

pages.title: Dois pratos
pages.layout: kitchen rehabilitation two-shot
pages.scene: Healer LEFT checks Tovo's right shoulder in school kitchen after removing rigid sling; Tovo RIGHT holds one empty clay plate and one plate with water, both at safe height; no heavy lifting; amber apron, no injury magically gone.

lines.speaker: Curandeira
lines.text: Sem saco pesado. Primeiro, controle.

lines.speaker: Tovo
lines.text: Se derramar o almoço, conto como exercício?

pages.title: O avental molhado
pages.layout: humorous restrained force test
pages.scene: Tovo LEFT cautiously amplifies his own arm strength for one brief instant and accidentally tips water from clay plate onto his amber kitchen apron, no extra arms; Oru RIGHT adult short gnome gestures stop; no supernatural aura or broken bones.

lines.speaker: Tovo
lines.text: Foi rápido demais! Molhei tudo.

lines.speaker: Oru
lines.text: Músculo não protege tendão nem louça.

pages.title: Uma pessoa, não um povo
pages.layout: orc-to-half-orc conversation at kitchen doorway
pages.scene: Braka LEFT tall powerful dark-olive-green orc woman one CHIPPED lower tusk and THREE long black braids, red wool cloak over practical armor, speaks to Tovo RIGHT broad sage-green half-orc short tight brown curls in wet amber apron. Not all orcs have his rare aptitude; she emphasizes teamwork.

lines.speaker: Braka
lines.text: Alguns têm esse impulso. Muitos nunca terão.

lines.speaker: Tovo
lines.text: Então vou aprender a dividir o peso.

pages.title: O selo de Maelor
pages.layout: official document and map two-shot
pages.scene: Ordelia LEFT in school secretariat opens an official copy of Maelor's letter claiming old canal; Eda RIGHT municipal surveyor compares land ledger. Seals and boundaries represented without readable invented words; no Maelor present.

lines.speaker: Ordelia
lines.text: Ele chama o porto de propriedade abandonada.

lines.speaker: Eda
lines.text: O título dele descreve o cais alto, não as estacas.

pages.title: Margens diferentes
pages.layout: two maps side-by-side object-only inset
pages.scene: Eda LEFT lays municipal cadastral map beside Adra's public-margin map, clearly different locations and no assumption of fraud; Ordelia RIGHT marks underground no-entry order but public walking permission still possible.

lines.speaker: Eda
lines.text: O procurador vedou galerias até vistoriar as matrículas.

lines.speaker: Ordelia
lines.text: A trilha pública continua em análise.

pages.title: A espada sem atalho
pages.layout: forge finishing work and blunt sword detail
pages.scene: Teren LEFT dark-skinned bald square grey beard offers Ilyan RIGHT his father's blunt short training blade while Ilyan files Folealto wheel plate; both in familiar east forge; concern about Maelor's legal tactic, no confrontation or travel yet.

lines.speaker: Teren
lines.text: Sua espada serviu para travar uma roda e recuar.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: Não vai me dar resposta sobre Mira.

pages.title: Pim retorna
pages.layout: follow-up consultation with finger-flex detail
pages.scene: Adult gnome Pim LEFT red headscarf full copper-grey beard returns to east infirmary by appointment; bandage removed temporarily, wound clean but two fingers stiff; healer RIGHT measures flexion with simple linen-marked strip. No new infection.

lines.speaker: Pim
lines.text: Não infeccionou, mas dois dedos enrijeceram.

lines.speaker: Curandeira
lines.text: Vamos medir antes de pedir outro ensaio.

pages.title: O movimento dele
pages.layout: water flow and patient exercise two-shot
pages.scene: Runa LEFT guides actual clean sun-warmed water beneath damp cloth from basin across Pim RIGHT hand; he flexes fingers by his OWN effort. Healer supervising outside this frame; no regrowth or instant restoration.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: Dobre os dedos você mesmo. Eu só guio a água.

lines.speaker: Pim
lines.text: A segunda junta move um pouco mais.

pages.title: A gota que manda parar
pages.layout: fatigue and measuring strip detail
pages.scene: Runa LEFT pales with nausea and lets one tiny water drop slip from practice cloth, stopping magic voluntarily; healer RIGHT compares before/after finger measurement on simple strip, noting rest and exercise may explain change. Pim, still in the infirmary, quietly reaches for medicine on a distant shelf without interrupting them.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: Parei. Estou ficando enjoada.

lines.speaker: Curandeira
lines.text: Registramos melhora pequena, sem prometer causa.

pages.title: A provocação
pages.layout: hostile school corridor with broad physical distance
pages.scene: Líria LEFT two tight dark braids chin scar chained notebook stands several paces across east corridor from Runa RIGHT straight black fringe septum left tattoo. Líria mocks Runa's medical effort; hostile glare, no smile, no companionable study, no touch.

lines.speaker: Líria
lines.text: Recebe elogios por lavar uma mão agora?

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: Foi uma mão ferida. Você sabe disso.

pages.title: A soleira
pages.layout: escalating adversarial two-shot
pages.scene: Runa LEFT replies sharply across several paces; Líria RIGHT face hardens beneath short chin scar, brass-chain notebook clenched. East corridor architecture consistent, open path between them; no violence yet.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: Prefiro cuidar dela a medir uma soleira depois da queda.

lines.speaker: Líria
lines.text: Escolha melhor o que usa contra mim.

pages.title: Crítica por escrito
pages.layout: disciplinary corridor two-shot
pages.scene: Líria LEFT holds her chained notebook and remains furious; Ordelia RIGHT stops her in the corridor and demands written technical criticism without patient harassment. Runa walked toward the infirmary and is outside the panel; no reconciliation.

lines.speaker: Líria
lines.text: Vou registrar a avaliação independente.

lines.speaker: Ordelia
lines.text: Crítica técnica, no papel. Ameaça, nunca mais.

pages.title: Licença com limites
pages.layout: council table permissions and three-stone map detail
pages.scene: Adra LEFT Enseada orc captain shell-bound dark braids presents her community's permit; Eda RIGHT municipal surveyor signs matching public-trail limits and return risk report in school common council; Talin's Faias rule of three ash boundary stones shown on map, no forest entry.

lines.speaker: Adra
lines.text: Estacas expostas e moradores; nada de abrir pedra.

lines.speaker: Eda
lines.text: Assino com os mesmos limites e relatório na volta.

pages.title: O ombro decide
pages.layout: functional shoulder check and two light boxes
pages.scene: Tovo LEFT tall sage-green half-orc short tight curls walks carrying TWO small equal light boxes, pauses at first sign of right-shoulder ache; healer RIGHT notes limited field clearance. Not a heavy lift; no force amplification allowed except supported emergency.

lines.speaker: Tovo
lines.text: Paro aqui. O ombro avisou.

lines.speaker: Curandeira
lines.text: Pode viajar e cozinhar. Nada de impulso por vaidade.

pages.title: Seis dias, duas barcas
pages.layout: budget ledger and route map two-shot
pages.scene: Ordelia LEFT checks two paid boats, six days bread, lodging deposit and limited lanterns on school register; Ilyan RIGHT signs rule that maps go first to Enseada for naming and access review. No legible exact text required.

lines.speaker: Ordelia
lines.text: Duas barcas, pão por seis dias, quartos pagos.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: E os mapas voltam primeiro à Enseada.

pages.title: Uma mecha, não uma arma
pages.layout: controlled fire close-up with wick-only inset
pages.scene: Ilyan LEFT guides a tiny flame from already lit charcoal to an oil-soaked wick on stone tray, then reaches for iron lid; Sere RIGHT notices banner flutter unexpectedly from Caio practicing OUTSIDE the forge and immediately orders exercises separated. No Caio visual and no giant flame. Sand bucket in background.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: A chama veio do carvão; o óleo a mantém.

lines.speaker: Sere
lines.text: Tampa. Caio treina vento em outro pátio.

pages.title: Três lugares, nenhuma certeza
pages.layout: intimate observatory with three-location map inset
pages.scene: Runa LEFT black straight hair fringe septum left floral tattoo sits beside Ilyan RIGHT long wavy black hair clean-shaven in known moonlit school observatory. She rests head lightly on his shoulder while both mark THREE DIFFERENT possible sites on Ereno copy: Maelor depot, Adra quay, uncertain third stake. Quiet intimacy, no kissing; still uncertain about Mira.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: Depósito, cais e estaca: são três pontos distintos.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: Mira pode não estar em nenhum. Mesmo assim iremos.

pages.title: Seis no portão
pages.layout: departure at south gate with six packs object detail
pages.scene: At established south gate of Casa das Quatro Luas at dawn, Sere LEFT dark-brown elven instructor one thick white braid and green cloak checks route ledger; Adra RIGHT slate-green orc ferry captain shell-bound black braids checks map; six labeled travel packs rest at gate, other four companions just outside this frame, no stranger added.

lines.speaker: Sere
lines.text: Conto seis: nós duas, Ilyan, Runa, Caio e Tovo.

lines.speaker: Adra
lines.text: A trilha passa pelo mercado e pelo cais leste.

pages.title: Pela rua do mercado
pages.layout: lively medieval market passage with cargo inset
pages.scene: Caio LEFT brown-skinned young guard short tidy reddish brown hair and teal tunic leads a small pack through crowded but background-UNIDENTIFIABLE Valecobre market; Tovo RIGHT tall sage-green half-orc brown tight curls carries only light cooking bundle, shoulder protected; the rest of six-person party nearby but outside frame.

lines.speaker: Caio
lines.text: Rua do mercado, depois cais leste.

lines.speaker: Tovo
lines.text: Minha panela pesa menos que o orgulho.

pages.title: A barca reservada
pages.layout: river embarkation with boat and rope detail
pages.scene: At east quay Adra LEFT slate-green orc ferry captain with shell-bound braids pays two local barqueiros only as indistinct distant back-facing silhouettes; Runa RIGHT black straight hair/fringe septum and floral left-arm tattoo steps onto reserved wooden boat carrying map case. Other travelers board off frame; second supply boat will cross next day.

lines.speaker: Adra
lines.text: Uma barca conosco; os mantimentos seguem amanhã.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: Guardei a cópia da licença no estojo seco.

pages.title: A margem oeste
pages.layout: wide road landscape and old tariff post inset
pages.scene: After normal boat crossing, Sere LEFT elven scout single long silver braid guides Ilyan RIGHT clean-shaven young man long wavy black hair on high western road past an old tariff post; boots wet, distant river behind them; rest of party walking just outside frame. Public trail not forest shortcut.

lines.speaker: Sere
lines.text: Poste de tarifa à frente. Ficamos na via pública.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: O rio mudou. A estrada ainda guarda marcas.

pages.title: O lugar ainda vive
pages.layout: inn threshold and inhabited port panorama
pages.scene: At a modest occupied river-port lodging house with orchard and stable, adult orc Hessa LEFT dark olive green skin broad face tiny lower tusks black braids with silver strands, SHORT scar above RIGHT eyebrow, ochre work shawl, opens door; Adra RIGHT slate-green orc shell-bound braids arrives with paid travel company outside frame. Visible small homes and lamp-lit windows prove Porto das Cinzas is inhabited, no abandoned ghost town. Do not confuse Hessa with Adra.

lines.speaker: Hessa
lines.text: Porto das Cinzas nunca ficou vazio.

lines.speaker: Adra
lines.text: Então o mapa apagou gente que ainda mora aqui.
